# external.tpa__sharethis_categories__v1

## Purpose
Static **snapshot of the ShareThis (DS17) 3P-interest category taxonomy** — the human-readable
name/path for every ShareThis category leaf that MNTN can target in a prospecting audience expression.
DS17 ShareThis is one of only three "bought 3P interest" sources with material daily IPDSC volume
(~65M rows/day; the others are DS35 LiveRamp IP and DS18 Dstillery — TI-999). Reach for this table
when you need to **decode a DS17 `data_source_category_id` into its category name/path** (e.g.
`251` → "Data for Good > Diversity Equity & Inclusion"), or to enumerate the ShareThis category
universe. This is the ShareThis-specific analog of the general `bronze.tpa.categories` catalog.

GCS backing: `gs://mntn-data-archive-prod/static/sharethis_categories/*.parquet` (Parquet, autodetect
schema). The `static/` archive path + all-NULL `updated_date` + `created_date` confined to
2024-01-01..2024-02-04 confirm this is a **one-time archived snapshot, not a refreshing feed** —
matching the prose finding "taxonomy 100% >2yr stale" (~2.5yr as of 2026-07).

## Grain & keys
- **Grain:** one row per ShareThis category node. 1,850 rows total (verified `COUNT(*)` 2026-07-19).
- **Primary key:** `data_source_category_id` — unique per row (1,850 distinct = 1,850 rows). This is the
  MNTN-side category id that appears in DS17 audience expressions / segments.
- **Vendor key:** `sharethis_id` — the ShareThis-native category id (4–11-char hex or numeric string),
  1,849 distinct; NULL only on the synthetic ROOT row.
- **Tree structure (effectively flat, 3 levels):** ROOT (`data_source_category_id=0`, `parent_id` NULL)
  → single "ShareThis" node (`id=1`, `parent_id=0`) → **1,848 targetable leaf categories all hanging
  directly off `parent_id=1`** (`is_leaf_node=true`). There is no genuine multi-level hierarchy in this
  snapshot — the ">"-delimited category names carry the semantic depth, not the `parent_id` chain.

## Column meanings (only the non-obvious ones)
- **data_source_id** — constant `17` for every row (= ShareThis in `integrationprod.data_sources` /
  `audience_data_sources`). This snapshot is DS17-only; it is NOT a multi-source catalog.
- **data_source_category_id** — MNTN-side category id = the **primary key** (unique). This is the value
  that appears as a DS17 leaf in audience expressions/segments. `0` = ROOT, `1` = the "ShareThis"
  container node, `>1` = real categories.
- **sharethis_id** — ShareThis's own native category id (4–11-char hex like `e48e50b9` or numeric like
  `44585420`). NULL on ROOT; the container node carries the literal string `"ROOT"`. Use
  `data_source_category_id` for MNTN joins, `sharethis_id` only when reconciling against ShareThis's feed.
- **parent_id** — FK to another row's `data_source_category_id`. NULL only on ROOT. Only two distinct
  non-null values exist (`0` for the ShareThis node, `1` for all 1,848 leaves) → the tree is flat.
- **partner_id** — constant `0` for all rows (not a meaningful partner discriminator here).
- **name / description / path** — **all three are identical on every row** (100%, verified) and hold the
  same ">"-delimited category path label, e.g. `"Autos & Vehicles > Vehicle Brands > Nissan > Frontier"`.
  `description` is NOT freeform prose here — it duplicates `name`. Pick any one.
- **names** — JSON string `{"names": ["ROOT","ShareThis","<category path>"]}` = the ancestor name array
  from root down. Stored as STRING; `JSON_EXTRACT_ARRAY` to parse. Never NULL.
- **path_from_root** — JSON string `{"pathFromRoot": [0,1,<id>]}` = the ancestor `data_source_category_id`
  array from ROOT to this node. Stored as STRING; never NULL.
- **is_leaf_node** — TRUE for the 1,848 targetable categories; FALSE only for ROOT and the "ShareThis"
  container. Filter `is_leaf_node=true` to get just the targetable universe.
- **navigation_only** — TRUE only on ROOT (a display container, not targetable); FALSE elsewhere.
- **advertiser_id** — **NULL for all 1,850 rows** → this is a SHARED catalog, not per-advertiser (unlike
  DS16 funnel tags in `bronze.tpa.categories`, which are advertiser-scoped).
- **deprecated** — FALSE for all rows (nothing marked deprecated in this snapshot).
- **public** — TRUE for all except ROOT (1,849/1,850).
- **sort_order** — **NULL on every row** — carries no ordering signal here; do not sort by it.
- **created_date** — DATE (not an epoch), ranges 2024-01-01..2024-02-04 (snapshot ingest window).
- **updated_date** — DATE, **NULL on every row** — confirms no post-snapshot updates were captured.

## Joins & relationships
- **DS17 audience expressions / segments → this table** on `data_source_category_id` (this side is the
  1:1 unique dimension; the expression side is the many side). This is a lookup/decode join — fan-out
  risk lives on the expression side, not here. Filter the fact side to `data_source_id=17` before joining.
- **`integrationprod.data_sources` / `audience_data_sources`** — `data_source_id=17` → "ShareThis".
  1:1 on the single DS17 row-key; trivially safe.
- **`bronze.tpa.categories`** — the general (all-DS) MNTN category catalog; this external table is the
  ShareThis-specific archived analog. Both key category rows on `data_source_category_id` within a
  `data_source_id`. (Partner-table live grain not re-verified this pass — treat as a decode dim, no
  fan-out from this side.)
- **`coredw.usage_reporting_data` / gold `reporting.ddp_all_matches_cpm`** carry a `sharethis_id` column
  for DS17 billing rows ($0.95 CPM, note the "starting May usage, previously $1.2" registry rate cut) —
  join on `sharethis_id` to attach category names to billed ShareThis usage. Those fact tables are
  per-impression/month grain (N per `sharethis_id`); joining this 1:1 dim to them fans out to their grain,
  which is expected.

## Gotchas
- **Static, ~2.5yr stale.** `updated_date` is NULL everywhere and `created_date` maxes at 2024-02-04.
  This snapshot will NOT reflect any ShareThis taxonomy changes since early 2024 — a DS17 category id
  seen live but absent here means the taxonomy drifted, not a data bug. Matches prose "taxonomy 100% >2yr stale".
- **name = description = path** on 100% of rows — don't expect `description` to add detail beyond the path.
- **Flat tree.** `parent_id` only distinguishes ROOT/container/leaf; do NOT try to reconstruct a deep
  category hierarchy from `parent_id`. Use the ">"-delimited `name`/`path` (or parse `names`) for depth.
- **`names` and `path_from_root` are STRING-encoded JSON**, not native ARRAY/STRUCT — you must
  `JSON_EXTRACT_ARRAY(...)` to work with them.
- **`sort_order` and `updated_date` are entirely NULL** — never use them for ordering or recency.
- **ROOT/container rows (`data_source_category_id` 0 and 1) are not targetable** (`navigation_only=true`
  on 0; `is_leaf_node=false` on both). Filter `is_leaf_node=true` to get the 1,848 real categories.
- **No `deleted`/`is_test` filters** — external GCS table, no CDC hygiene columns (and none are needed:
  `deprecated=false` everywhere).

## Cost & partitioning notes
- **External GCS-backed Parquet — no BigQuery partitioning or clustering, no partition pruning.** Any
  `SELECT` reads the full GCS object; there is no partition column to filter on and none is needed.
- **Dry-run is uninformative for this source:** `SELECT *` dry-run reports "lower bound of 0 bytes" —
  BQ cannot estimate federated-GCS bytes ahead of time (verified 2026-07-19). `bq show` reports
  `numBytes=0` / `numRows=0` (external tables carry no BQ storage metadata) — expected, not an error.
- **The object is tiny (1,850 rows, one small Parquet file)** so a full scan is negligible; there is no
  filter you *must* apply for cost. The only meaningful filter is semantic: `WHERE is_leaf_node=true`
  (or `public=true`) to exclude the ROOT/container rows.

## Example queries
```sql
-- Decode DS17 category ids → names (the common lookup)
SELECT data_source_category_id, sharethis_id, name
FROM `dw-main-bronze.external.tpa__sharethis_categories__v1`
WHERE is_leaf_node = TRUE
ORDER BY data_source_category_id;

-- Attach ShareThis category names to billed DS17 usage
SELECT u.reporting_month, u.sharethis_id, c.name, u.impressions, u.usage
FROM `dw-main-bronze.coredw.usage_reporting_data` u
JOIN `dw-main-bronze.external.tpa__sharethis_categories__v1` c
  USING (sharethis_id)
WHERE u.data_source_id = 17;
```
